pseudocode: Sanitizes Markdown chapters/slices and renders them to XHTML with MathML using an offset-safe HTML block extractor.
Guards HTMLExtractor closing-tag slicing and resets line-offset caches across HTMLParser.goahead buffer slices.
Verifies rendered XHTML spines introduce no prose paragraph repetitions beyond their source Markdown counts.
Upgrades rendered Markdown footnotes to EPUB 3 noteref links and aside footnote blocks with NCName IDs and sequential per-chapter numbering.
Promotes TOC-anchored chapter headings to h1, strips running headers, demotes dialogue/Bkz. lines, normalizes subheadings to h2/h3, and isolates back-cover blurbs.
Drops image references below minimum width, height, or pixel area and rewrites surviving image paths.
Fills Dublin Core metadata from description.json, inferred headings, or interactive prompts.
Verifies prose deduplication and XML/XHTML syntax across spines and package files, then writes the EPUB archive.
Reads a Markdown chapter and, unless non-interactive, asks whether to open it for editing before packaging.
Splits a Markdown document at chapter anchors into separate XHTML spine files and rewrites cross-document links.
Links İçindekiler entries to body headings via monotonic DP, strips TOC images, merges wrapped rows, and reconciles titles.
Aligns TOC items monotonically to candidate body headings via dynamic programming.
Reconciles aligned TOC and body titles word-by-word and Roman-prefix-by-sequence to pick the cleanest title.
Auto-detects manzum chapters, infers periodic counter step, and renders sequence-verified margin line numbers.
Scans forward for expected = prev + step counters across OCR splits, clipped hundreds, and page-break gaps.
Repairs marker-pdf split HTML entities, balances orphan inline formatting tags per line, and escapes bare &# sequences.
Converts one PDF with marker-pdf, runs glyph repair and HTML/entity sanitization, and writes Markdown, metadata, and images.
Extracts bottom-of-page footnotes via PDF rule geometry and Markdown markers, reassembles multi-page notes, links inline callouts, and rejoins page-break prose splits.
Aligns PDF footnote zones monotonically to Markdown block spans via dynamic programming over character n-gram candidates.
Scans PDF pages with pypdfium2, merges colinear lower-page horizontal rules, extracts body bounds and footnote zones, and releases handles before close.
Collects PDF paths from a file or a directory and rejects a path that is missing or not a PDF.
Parses the CLI, converts each queued PDF to Markdown, and packages an EPUB unless that step is skipped.
Parses a document as XML and returns every syntax error with its line, column, and message.
Walks the tag stack past the parser's 100-error cap and records later unclosed, stray, and non-empty void tags.
Repairs XHTML when the syntax check fails, and raises with file, line, column, and message when a document still will not parse.
Rewrites broken HTML into well-formed XHTML by stripping illegal characters, fixing comments, and reserializing a recovered HTML tree.
Replaces double hyphens inside comments so the comment stays legal XML.
Parses broken markup with the HTML recovery parser and serializes it as XML so tags, entities, and nesting become well-formed.
